{{Quote|Oh, I hate space travel! At least Hrill is a nice, quiet planet, from what I've heard.|C-3PO|<ref name="Escape from the Monster Ship: A Droid Adventure">''[[Escape from the Monster Ship: A Droid Adventure]]''</ref>}}
'''Hrill''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] reputed to be peaceful, quiet, and dull. In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Mungo Baobab]] was assigned a mission to Hrill by the [[Baobab Merchant Council|Merchant Council]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Manda/Legends|Manda]]. Nevertheless, Baobab ignored the order and ventured off in search of the [[Roon system/Legends|Roon system]] and its fabled [[Roonstone]]s. He brought the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] with him.
